### Why DO NOT SHIP
Items 1–3 are correctness bugs in the two flows that most resemble real product surfaces (checkout pricing and form submission) — these are exactly the kind of defects that would corrupt user-facing data or charge the wrong amount in a real app. Items 4–5 show at least two controls are entirely non-functional. Given this is a purpose-built bench/target app, these are plausibly seeded defects, but by the app's own functional bar, it should not ship as-is."
